Morgan's introduction comes in Season 2 of Extant, which underwent a major genre shift. Gone is the creeping paranoia and slow-burn mystery, replaced by the breakneck action that's fueled other sci-fi blockbusters like Minority Report or I, Robot. Molly's search for answers becomes a fight to contain the threat she brought home, giving Berry a more action-driven role in the second season.

Part of that shift was because Season 1 was not scoring the ratings that CBS would have hoped for, despite having the star power of Berry and Spielberg. Yet it wasn't enough to save Extant, as the series was eventually canceled after two seasons. Despite its short lifespan, Extant found another audience when it arrived on Netflix in 2025. As of September 2026, both seasons are available to stream on Paramount+.

She was slated to star in The Mothership, a Netflix film featuring a woman who embarks on an intergalactic journey to save her husband. Like Extant, it would have featured Berry playing a wife and mother who embarks on a journey to the stars, and more than likely blended sci-fi tropes with plenty of action.

Netflix eventually wound up shelving the film due to multiple factors, including production issues and reshoots made difficult by the passage of time. Netflix's chief content officer Bela Bajaria eventually discussed the reason why The Mothership was shelved: "There [were] just a lot of issues during production and stuff, creatively, so everybody just felt like it was the right thing to not do it and do something else together eventually.”

Despite The Mothership not taking off, both Halle Berry and Steven Spielberg have continued to be involved in science fiction projects. Berry took the lead role in Roland Emmerich's sci-fi disaster epic Moonfall, while Spielberg continued to produce other sci-fi shows including SyFy's sleeper hit Resident Alien and Halo (which eventually found new life on Netflix). Though Extant didn't find an audience when it was first airing, its high-concept premise, unnerving first season, and compelling performance from Halle Berry make it worth a watch.

You fight — not because you have to, but because standing aside isn't something you're capable of.

In Star Wars, that willingness is what makes all the difference.

Morgan's introduction comes in Season 2 of Extant, which underwent a major genre shift. Gone is the creeping paranoia and slow-burn mystery, replaced by the breakneck action that's fueled other sci-fi blockbusters like Minority Report or I, Robot. Molly's search for answers becomes a fight to contain the threat she brought home, giving Berry a more action-driven role in the second season.

Part of that shift was because Season 1 was not scoring the ratings that CBS would have hoped for, despite having the star power of Berry and Spielberg. Yet it wasn't enough to save Extant, as the series was eventually canceled after two seasons. Despite its short lifespan, Extant found another audience when it arrived on Netflix in 2025. As of September 2026, both seasons are available to stream on Paramount+.

Berry Was Set to Star in Another Sci-Fi Project After 'Extant'

Extant isn't the only time that Berry would star in a sci-fi project centered around space. She was slated to star in The Mothership, a Netflix film featuring a woman who embarks on an intergalactic journey to save her husband. Like Extant, it would have featured Berry playing a wife and mother who embarks on a journey to the stars, and more than likely blended sci-fi tropes with plenty of action.

Netflix eventually wound up shelving the film due to multiple factors, including production issues and reshoots made difficult by the passage of time. Netflix's chief content officer Bela Bajaria eventually discussed the reason why The Mothership was shelved: "There [were] just a lot of issues during production and stuff, creatively, so everybody just felt like it was the right thing to not do it and do something else together eventually.”

Despite The Mothership not taking off, both Halle Berry and Steven Spielberg have continued to be involved in science fiction projects. Berry took the lead role in Roland Emmerich's sci-fi disaster epic Moonfall, while Spielberg continued to produce other sci-fi shows including SyFy's sleeper hit Resident Alien and Halo (which eventually found new life on Netflix). Though Extant didn't find an audience when it was first airing, its high-concept premise, unnerving first season, and compelling performance from Halle Berry make it worth a watch.
